observations: Two rectangular solar panels leaning against a wall, both with white frames and dark photovoltaic cells.
The panels appear to be of similar size and design, with visible grid lines and small white dots (busbars) on the cells.
One panel has noticeable yellowish discoloration or staining on several cells, particularly in the lower half.
The panels are partially wrapped in clear plastic, suggesting recent handling or cleaning.
In the foreground, there is a cardboard box with black cables or connectors and a yellow battery box labeled 'Eastmo' with '12V-200Ah' visible.
The setting is outdoors on a concrete surface, with a wall and some greenery in the background.
A watermark 'FBJ GREEN ENERGIES POSTED ON JUJU' is visible across the image.

No visible brand, country of origin, or certification marks. 'American' cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
Photo 0 shows yellowish discoloration or staining on cells of the right panel, indicating potential degradation or damage, which contradicts 'neat quality'.
